name: agent-self-knowledge
description: Makes Claude research how Claude Code, Cowork, the Claude apps, the Agent SDK and the Claude API work today instead of answering from memory. One command routes the task through a table of documentation areas, reads every related live page, keeps the sections about the topic, follows their links one hop and checks six months of release notes; the answer cites exact URLs and verbatim quotes and lists what it could not verify.
